name: How long does a garage door upgrade installation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a garage door upgrade installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most standard garage door upgrade installations can be completed within a single day, typically taking between 4 to 8 hours. This timeframe includes the removal of the old door, installation of the new door and tracks, and setup of a new opener if required. However, complex installations involving custom doors, extensive framing modifications, or unexpected issues can sometimes extend the project duration. Your contractor will provide a more precise timeline based on the specifics of your project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most standard garage door upgrades take 4-8 hours to install. Complex projects may take longer.
